text: Canonical statuses distinguish passed, failed, unknown, not_evaluated, no_population, unsupported, indeterminate, and error.

A common evidence envelope records project, definition, dgId/source representation, input/output hashes, schema/ontology/rule/shape versions, service/version, provider/model where applicable, timestamps, warnings, and status.
Unsupported built-ins and predicate forms never collapse into ordinary failed verdicts.
Mixed per-object outcomes remain distinct through persistence and C# retrieval; no run-level aggregate is replicated across objects.
